ctx.x:
February 1st, 1979, tape four, Jacques
Butler at his home, 65 2nd Avenue in New York City.
Before we commence talking about Mr. Butler's adventures in Canada, I'd like to get you to talk a bit about Charlie Christian and Oscar.
Well, I haven't heard from Charlie Christian because when I come back to America, Charlie Christian had passed away.
